test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Mad
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e. **'Sound'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym for the word **"Mad"** is: **'Sound'**
 
• **"Mad" **is an adjective which can mean mentally ill or insane, or extremely foolish or angry, depending on the context.
 
• **"Sound"** is used here as an adjective meaning in good condition; not damaged, injured, or diseased.
 
• In a **mental health context**, it is often used to mean mentally healthy or sane, which is the opposite of the mental illness or insanity aspect of "mad."

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Sound'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** "Indisposition"** is a slight illness or unwillingness, and does not carry a meaning opposite to "mad."
 
• **"Distemper" **is a viral disease of some animals, particularly dogs, or a state of agitation or disorder. It does not represent the opposite of "mad."
 
• **"Dense" **typically means closely compacted in substance or slow to understand. It does not stand as an antonym to "mad."
